variables.value: A man enters a library and walks up to the librarian at the desk and says loudly, "I'd like a cheeseburger with fries, hold the ketchup!".¬The librarian replies in whispered tones, "But sir, this is a library!".¬Coming to his senses, the man replies in a whispered tone, "Can I please have a cheeseburger with fries, hold the ketchup."

contents: ¬"If you want to create an apple pie from Scratch, then you must first create the universe."¬¬                            Carl Sagan

There were two men, Bob and Phil. Phil said to Bob that he could drop his watch off the top of the balcony and catch it.¬He then dropped his watch and sprinted down the stairs and caught it!¬Not to be outdone, Bob then dropped his watch, walked down the stairs, ate a sandwich and still caught his watch! Phil asked how he did it? Bob explained his watch was always 5 minutes slow!" :)

A man enters a library and walks up to the librarian at the desk and says loudly, "I'd like a cheeseburger with fries, hold the ketchup!".¬The librarian replies in whispered tones, "But sir, this is a library!".¬Coming to his senses, the man replies in a whispered tone, "Can I please have a cheeseburger with fries, hold the ketchup."

The font is the 'Hershey Vector Font' which can be found here: ~c7http:////paulbourke.net//dataformats//hershey//¬<~c8The font has a variable width & editor will space letters and wrap words to lines accordingly.
